title: Modification of topographic features on Tier I sites
previewText:

blocks.html: (a)        development, enlargement and site alteration is not feasible without such modification, or that the requested modification will permit a development, enlargement or site alteration that satisfies the purposes of this Chapter;

blocks.html: (b)        such modification, including any removal of topsoil, will not disturb the drainage pattern and soil conditions in the area;

blocks.html: (d)        such modification is the least modification required to achieve the purpose for which it is granted; and

blocks.html: (e)        the development, enlargement or site alteration takes advantage of the natural characteristics of the site.

blocks.html: Where permits are required from a City agency, the Commission shall request a report from such agency, and the provisions of Section 105-93 (Inter-agency Coordination) shall apply.
